shared_elements: tall vertical slab / pillar-like rectangular block
shallow relief cut into rock (partial anthropomorphic-looking form in B)
photographed outdoors against blue sky with rubble at base
justification: Both show pale limestone with a tall rectangular slab standing proud of the surrounding rock, and B's central raised element vaguely echoes the pillar shape of A, which is the only real correspondence. A, however, carries a dense, deliberate programme of figural low reliefs in stacked registers (birds, quadrupeds, snake-like forms, discs), whereas B's surface is essentially blank quarried or weathered bedrock with at most a roughed-out, ambiguous protrusion and no legible imagery or ordering.
